configuration: All 16 upstream check_data input rows through the editable F16_aero API; frozen input and expected-output rows are check-owned.
observable: Every official model output, keyed by fixed input row, retaining upstream physical units.
default_vs_upstream: All 16 official model input rows, original units; no temporal sampling or plotting.
variant: Two upward binary64 ULPs on one active nonzero input in the final official model check row; all other inputs unchanged.
altbuild: none: no alternative compiled target build is declared for this Python module; platform robustness remains a calibration/review limitation.

evidence.floor_how: No alternative build declared, so the CLI floor remains null. Separate Windows Python 3.12.14 versus Linux container Python 3.12.10 comparison passed; per-observable measurements are in comment/validation-evidence.json. This does not establish all-platform robustness.

warrant: Every output of the fixed official input rows is compared under the absolute and relative model bounds in its original units; the standalone generated-model constants are also mandatory. The pinned F16 routines evaluate smooth lookup/polynomial expressions at these inputs, so two-ULP input noise gives a measured Docker spread of 4.44089e-16, well within the proposed precision budget without requiring bitwise agreement. Windows and Linux pristine outputs also pass. Aerodynamic force-sign and input-axis faults, and propulsion force-unit scaling, fail these gates after successful execution. The curator approved this model-preservation tolerance after calibration; it is not mechanically tightened to the two-ULP spread.
calibration_status: Curator finalized the full calibration proposal after the first Docker selfcheck: approved proposal, disclose limitations and continue submitting the PR (2026-09-07).
